_doc: V2 'Special' shop section items that are not classes (classes live in src/classes.json).
Fields: charge = take price from the purse before running buy;
slot = needs a free inventory slot (refuse when full, as other items). buy = function run as/at the buyer after paying:
it gives the item / does the effect itself. charge false = buy decides everything (no purse change by the shop).
v2 = the V2 WhiteShop/BlackShop id. Sold on the shop Special page: src/shop.json {special: id} -> tools/build_shop.py -> shop/buy_special.

items.name: Emerald Talisman
items.blurb: Fortune comes for those who seek it. Worn on the head: luck, and coins while it stays there. It does not come off.
